result.title: Beyond Restoration: Content-Degradation Factor Unfolding for Real-World Concealed Object Segmentation
result.summary: Reliable visual perception under degradation requires distinguishing task-relevant content from degradation-induced variations, especially in concealed object segmentation (COS), where foreground cues are inherently weak. The central challenge is not merely improving visibility, but identifying reliable content evidence amid degradation-induced variations. RGB-space segmentation often entangles content and degradation cues, while restoration-based methods primarily focus on image recovery and task interaction. This motivates explicit factorization to distinguish content evidence from degradation effects and assess its reliability. Retinex provides a spatially aligned basis for this separation but remains illumination-centric. We therefore extend it to content-degradation formation with task-asymmetric factor roles. The Factor Unfolding Network (FUN) uses the content factor R as the sole source of direct semantic evidence for segmentation, while the degradation factor L captures degradation-related variations and generates a spatial reliability map to calibrate this evidence. A unified energy couples observation formation with reliability-weighted foreground-background separation, and its alternating updates yield a coarse-to-fine network without clean-image supervision. In this way, FUN factorizes degradation for perception rather than removing it. Extensive experiments across clean and degraded conditions and diverse segmentation tasks demonstrate robust performance and generalization. Code will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Factor Unfolding Network，将 Retinex 扩展为「内容-退化」因子分解：以内容因子作为分割语义证据的唯一来源，退化因子生成空间可靠度图校准该证据，并通过统一能量的交替更新实现无需干净图像监督的粗到精分割。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「内容因子独占语义证据、退化因子只输出可靠度权重」的非对称分工与可靠性加权线索，可能对应 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与无关变化抑制，可供核查能否迁移为 latent 状态中证据可靠度的门控机制。
